title: Burger & fries
text: Exploding layers and flying fries made for the first second of a Reel
idea: The burger comes apart layer by layer in mid-air so every ingredient is on show, with fries flying around it. Motion starts in the very first frame, because on Reels people decide in about a second.
why: Movement from frame one, made for the scroll.
Every ingredient visible: the ad shows the product instead of describing it.
Eight seconds, short enough to loop and replay.
